originalLicenseNote: Engine source under MIT; embeds the network pulsar.bin (release nn-pulsar-dev-0d99364) from https://github.com/tgirolami09/Prune-nets (MIT), trained on the engine's self-play data.
blurb: Prune 4.0.1 is the July 2026 release of Thomas Girolami and Joachim Bienvenue's MIT-licensed C++ UCI chess engine, trained on its own self-play games with bullet. It pairs fully legal magic-bitboard move generation, singular, double and negative extensions, internal iterative reductions, null-move, reverse futility, late-move and history pruning, and pawn, minor-piece and continuation correction histories with an embedded NNUE that adds threat inputs to its king-bucketed piece-square features, a 384-wide pairwise hidden layer and 8 output buckets. Adapted to UCI over WASI with the poll helper in its input thread's place, its 128-bit net code compiled to WebAssembly SIMD through SIMDe.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build on the C poll helper, with no input thread and Threads fixed to 1; the engine's 128-bit SSE path through SIMDe to WebAssembly SIMD, with node counts equal to the native x86-64-v2 build's (its AVX2 path searches other nodes); no Syzygy tablebases; Hash capped at 1024 MB.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Fully legal move generation on magic bitboards, from a magic table compiled into the engine.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Principal variation search with iterative deepening and aspiration windows.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Null-move pruning with tuned depth and eval-margin reductions.

features.label: Reverse Futility Pruning
features.implementation: Separate margins for improving and non-improving positions, with razoring at depth 1.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: One ply less where the hash entry is missing or too shallow.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Singular, double and negative extensions, with a negative extension on cut nodes.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Logarithmic reductions adjusted by history and for tactical moves.

features.label: Late-Move & History Pruning
features.implementation: Late-move, quiet and capture history, and futility pruning in the moves loop.

features.label: Quiescence Search
features.implementation: Captures with SEE pruning in leaf nodes.

features.label: Histories & Correction
features.implementation: Quiet and capture histories with killer moves, plus pawn, minor-piece, previous-move and continuation correction histories.

features.label: MVV-LVA & SEE
features.implementation: Captures ordered by MVV-LVA and SEE after the PV move.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Buckets of three entries with age, bounds, static evals and PV flags.

features.label: NNUE
features.implementation: Embedded integer net: threat inputs and 768 inputs in 4 mirrored king buckets, a 384-wide pairwise hidden layer, then 16, 32 and 1 in 8 output buckets.
